verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists an agent mode with agent clusters, a Deep Research feature, and a Kimi browser extension, and its coding tools document web search. Together these cover the 'research on the web' part of the story only thinly. None of the evidence states that the assistant actually drives a browser, clicking, filling forms or completing tasks on websites; the extension is only named, with no description of what it does. missing for 10: documented browser-control/computer-use capability, evidence of completing multi-step tasks on websites, description of what the browser extension does, hands-on or independent corroboration.
